vaccine_carrier_voyage.name: Vaccine Voyage
vaccine_carrier_voyage.observation: Orphan boys are vaccinated one after another across the ocean so that the cowpox arrives alive in the colonies.
vaccine_carrier_voyage.social_consequence: The orphans who carry the lymph are never asked; the colonies receive vaccine and a new debt of fear.

slow_sand_filtration.observation: Town water is run slowly through beds of fine sand, and it comes out clear and far less likely to carry fever.
slow_sand_filtration.ability_reason: A whole town can drink filtered water from one works.
slow_sand_filtration.social_consequence: The water company now answers to the town for the purity of what it sells.

isolated_poppy_alkaloid.name: Pure Opiate
isolated_poppy_alkaloid.observation: The sleeping principle of opium is drawn out as a pure white salt and given by the grain.
isolated_poppy_alkaloid.social_consequence: Pain is dulled by exact doses, and the pure drug makes its own slaves.

public_vaccine_stations.name: Vaccine Stations
public_vaccine_stations.observation: Public stations keep the cowpox alive arm to arm and vaccinate the poor for nothing.
public_vaccine_stations.social_consequence: A vaccinator is appointed in each district and keeps the register of the protected.

planned_abdominal_operation.name: Abdominal Operation
planned_abdominal_operation.observation: A surgeon opens the belly by plan and removes a tumour the size of a child's head, and the patient lives.

chest_listening_tube.name: Listening Tube
chest_listening_tube.observation: A wooden tube laid on the chest lets the physician hear the lungs crackle and the heart murmur.

human_blood_transfusion.name: Blood Transfusion
human_blood_transfusion.observation: Blood is run from a donor's arm into a woman bleeding after childbirth, and sometimes she lives.

fever_bark_alkaloid.name: Pure Fever-bark Salt
fever_bark_alkaloid.observation: The bitter principle of fever bark is purified and given by weight, and the intermittent fever breaks.

iodine_goitre_treatment.name: Iodine for Goitre
iodine_goitre_treatment.observation: Goitre shrinks under measured drops of iodine, though too much causes its own trouble.

national_pharmacopoeia.name: National Pharmacopoeia
national_pharmacopoeia.observation: One national book fixes the drugs, their preparation and their strengths, and every apothecary must follow it.

hospital_medical_schools.name: Hospital Schools
hospital_medical_schools.observation: Students walk the wards, dissect in the dead-house and sit examinations set by the hospital staff.

croup_tracheotomy.name: Croup Tracheotomy
croup_tracheotomy.observation: When a child chokes with croup the surgeon opens the windpipe below the throat and sets a silver tube.

epidemic_house_visiting.name: House Visiting
epidemic_house_visiting.observation: In a purging-sickness year visitors go house to house, and cleansing orders are served on the filthiest courts.
epidemic_house_visiting.social_consequence: Visitors force their way into the courts; the poor resent the cleansing officers and hide the sick.

intravenous_saline.name: Saline Infusion
intravenous_saline.observation: Salt water is run into the veins of those dying of the purging sickness, and some rise from the bed.

anatomy_body_supply_law.name: Anatomy Law
anatomy_body_supply_law.observation: By law the unclaimed dead of workhouses go to the anatomy schools, and grave-robbing stops.
anatomy_body_supply_law.social_consequence: The poor dread dying on the parish, for then their bodies are cut open.

numerical_treatment_method.name: Counting Method
numerical_treatment_method.observation: Physicians count cured and dead among numbered cases, and bleeding proves useless or worse.
numerical_treatment_method.social_consequence: Old physicians lose face and custom as bleeding is abandoned.

dental_surgery_licence.name: Dental Licence
dental_surgery_licence.observation: Tooth-drawers must train at a dental school and hold a licence.

sanitary_town_survey.name: Sanitary Survey
sanitary_town_survey.observation: A survey of the labouring towns shows fever thickest where filth, crowding and bad water meet.
sanitary_town_survey.social_consequence: The survey names streets and landlords; the town's rich are shamed and angry.

ether_anaesthesia.name: Ether Anaesthesia
ether_anaesthesia.observation: The patient breathes ether vapour from a flask and feels nothing while the surgeon cuts.
ether_anaesthesia.ability_reason: Surgeons can take their time; operations once impossible for pain become possible.

chlorine_handwashing.name: Chlorine Hand-washing
chlorine_handwashing.observation: Students washing in chlorine water before the lying-in ward cut childbed fever to a tenth.
chlorine_handwashing.social_consequence: Physicians take offence at being called carriers of death, and the practice is resisted for years.

chloroform_anaesthesia.name: Chloroform
chloroform_anaesthesia.observation: Chloroform dropped on a cloth brings sleep for surgery and eases hard labour.

central_board_of_health.name: Board of Health
central_board_of_health.observation: A central board of health with local boards can order drains laid, nuisances abated and water supplied.
central_board_of_health.ability_reason: Towns now have a standing health authority with power over drains and water.
central_board_of_health.social_consequence: Local boards and medical officers join the town council; property owners fight the rates.

water_service_inspections.observation: Inspectors test the supplies and trace every foul tap back to a cracked main or cross connection.

compulsory_infant_vaccination.name: Compulsory Vaccination
compulsory_infant_vaccination.observation: Every infant must be vaccinated within months of birth and a certificate kept by the registrar.
compulsory_infant_vaccination.social_consequence: Parents who refuse are fined; leagues against compulsion march in the streets.

hypodermic_syringe.name: Hypodermic Syringe
hypodermic_syringe.observation: A hollow needle and syringe put a dose beneath the skin in a moment.

contagion_mapping.observation: Cases are marked house by house on a street map, and a cluster round one pump shows the sickness comes in the water.
contagion_mapping.ability_reason: Outbreaks can be traced to a source and stopped at it.

nursing_care_organization.observation: Trained nurses in ranks under ward sisters keep military hospitals clean, fed and aired, and the death rate falls by half.
nursing_care_organization.ability_reason: Hospitals stop killing the patients sent to them.
nursing_care_organization.social_consequence: Nursing becomes a respectable calling for women, with its own ranks and matrons.

medical_officer_of_health.name: Medical Officer
medical_officer_of_health.observation: Each district has a medical officer who reports its deaths and names its worst streets every year.

cellular_pathology.name: Cellular Pathology
cellular_pathology.observation: Disease is seen under the microscope in the body's own cells.

medical_practitioner_register.name: Practitioner Register
medical_practitioner_register.observation: One public register lists qualified practitioners; unlicensed healers may not hold public posts.
medical_practitioner_register.social_consequence: Wise women and bonesetters lose standing; the register becomes a guild's gate.

district_visiting_nurses.name: District Nurses
district_visiting_nurses.observation: Nurses visit the sick poor in their own homes and teach families to wash, air and feed them.

casualty_collection_posts.observation: Marked posts behind the line let bearers find the wounded and the wounded find the bearers.

field_aid_stations.observation: Surgeons work at aid stations just behind the fighting line, and wounds are dressed within hours.

nurse_training_school.name: Nurse Training School
nurse_training_school.observation: A training school takes probationers for a year of ward work and lectures before they may call themselves nurses.

casualty_transfer_records.observation: A tag and record follow each wounded man from the post to the base hospital.

triage_registers.observation: The wounded are sorted into those who can wait, those who must be treated now and those beyond help.

evacuation_relays.observation: Relays of wagons and hospital trains carry the wounded back to base hospitals.

neutral_wounded_convention.name: Wounded Convention
neutral_wounded_convention.observation: Realms agree by treaty that field hospitals, their staff and their badge are not to be fired on.
neutral_wounded_convention.social_consequence: Generals must now respect the badge; breaking the treaty shames the realm abroad.

pavilion_ward_hospitals.name: Pavilion Hospitals
pavilion_ward_hospitals.observation: Hospitals are built as separate pavilions with windows on both sides, and the air of the wards stays fresh.

antiseptic_surgery.name: Antiseptic Surgery
antiseptic_surgery.observation: Wounds, dressings and hands are washed in carbolic acid, and amputations stop festering.
antiseptic_surgery.ability_reason: Surgery stops being a gamble with gangrene and hospital fever.

germ_theory_of_disease.name: Germ Theory
germ_theory_of_disease.observation: Specific living germs are grown in pure culture and shown to cause specific diseases.
germ_theory_of_disease.ability_reason: Every measure against disease can now aim at a known enemy: water, milk, wound, carrier.
germ_theory_of_disease.social_consequence: The old doctrine of bad airs falls; sanitation officers gain a science to command with.

isolation_fever_hospitals.name: Isolation Hospitals
isolation_fever_hospitals.observation: Children with scarlet fever and diphtheria are carted to isolation hospitals outside the town.
isolation_fever_hospitals.social_consequence: Families fear the fever van and hide their sick children.

consumption_germ_identified.name: Consumption Germ
consumption_germ_identified.observation: A stain shows the slender germ of the wasting cough in the sputum of every consumptive.

worker_sickness_insurance.name: Sickness Insurance
worker_sickness_insurance.observation: Workers and employers pay into sickness funds that pay the doctor and a weekly sick pay.
worker_sickness_insurance.ability_reason: The sick worker no longer drags himself to the mill, and families are not ruined by one illness.
worker_sickness_insurance.social_consequence: Sickness funds become a pillar of the state; physicians fight the funds over fees.

local_anaesthesia.name: Local Anaesthesia
local_anaesthesia.observation: A drug from the coca leaf numbs the eye or the skin, and small operations need no sleeping gas.

attenuated_laboratory_vaccine.name: Laboratory Vaccine
attenuated_laboratory_vaccine.observation: A germ weakened in the laboratory protects against the madness of dogs' bite.

aseptic_operating_room.name: Aseptic Surgery
aseptic_operating_room.observation: Instruments, gowns and dressings are steamed sterile, and surgeons operate in gloves and masks.

consumption_sanatoria.name: Sanatoria
consumption_sanatoria.observation: Consumptives rest in the open air of mountain and seaside sanatoria, away from their families.

disease_notification_law.name: Notification Law
disease_notification_law.observation: Physicians must notify the health office of every case of an infectious disease within a day.

diphtheria_antitoxin.name: Diphtheria Antitoxin
diphtheria_antitoxin.observation: Serum from horses given the croup germ saves choking children when injected early.
diphtheria_antitoxin.ability_reason: Childhood's cruellest killer now has a cure.

port_sanitary_inspection.name: Port Inspection
port_sanitary_inspection.observation: Port doctors inspect each ship and isolate only the sick, instead of holding every ship for forty days.

shared_death_cause_list.name: Shared Cause List
shared_death_cause_list.observation: Realms agree one list of causes of death, and their tables can be compared.

bone_shadow_imaging.name: Bone Imaging
bone_shadow_imaging.observation: Invisible rays cast shadow pictures of bones and bullets through the flesh.

enteric_fever_vaccine.name: Enteric Vaccine
enteric_fever_vaccine.observation: Soldiers are inoculated against enteric fever, and camp fevers no longer kill more than bullets.

mosquito_fever_vector.name: Mosquito Vector
mosquito_fever_vector.observation: Marsh fever and yellow fever are shown to pass through the bite of certain mosquitoes.

synthetic_willow_analgesic.name: Willow Powder
synthetic_willow_analgesic.observation: A synthetic powder from willow chemistry brings down fever and eases pain.

blood_group_typing.name: Blood Groups
blood_group_typing.observation: Blood is sorted into groups that can safely be mixed, and transfusion stops killing.

mosquito_control_brigades.name: Mosquito Brigades
mosquito_control_brigades.observation: Brigades drain pools, oil standing water and screen windows, and the marsh fever retreats.

talking_cure.name: Talking Cure
talking_cure.observation: Disorders of the mind are treated by long conversation between patient and physician.

radium_tumour_therapy.name: Radium Therapy
radium_tumour_therapy.observation: Radium and rays are turned on tumours; some shrink, and some healers burn.

school_medical_inspection.name: School Inspection
school_medical_inspection.observation: Every pupil is examined at school for lice, bad eyes, bad teeth and infection.

water_chlorination.name: Water Chlorination
water_chlorination.observation: A measured dose of chlorine in town water kills its fever germs, and enteric fever nearly vanishes.
water_chlorination.ability_reason: Every tap in the town delivers water that does not carry fever.

targeted_arsenical_drug.name: Targeted Arsenical
targeted_arsenical_drug.observation: An arsenic compound made to seek out the pox germ cures many, though its doses are dangerous.

laboratory_medical_schools.name: Laboratory Schools
laboratory_medical_schools.observation: Medical schools are bound to laboratories and teaching hospitals, and the weak schools are closed.

drug_label_purity_law.name: Drug Purity Law
drug_label_purity_law.observation: Drug labels must state what is in the bottle, and poisons and habit-forming drugs must be named.

medical_resupply_packing.observation: Dressings and drugs travel in standard sealed sets, so every aid post knows what it holds.

convalescent_duty_reviews.observation: Boards review convalescents and decide who returns to the line and who needs more care.

reconstructive_surgery.name: Reconstructive Surgery
reconstructive_surgery.observation: Surgeons rebuild faces and hands shattered in war with grafts of skin and bone.

stored_citrated_blood.name: Stored Blood
stored_citrated_blood.observation: Blood kept from clotting with citrate is stored cold behind the lines and given to the wounded.

pandemic_closure_orders.name: Pandemic Closures
pandemic_closure_orders.observation: In a world pandemic the halls and schools are closed, masks worn and cases reported.

consumption_vaccine.name: Consumption Vaccine
consumption_vaccine.observation: A weakened cattle germ given to infants guards against the wasting cough.

insulin_therapy.name: Insulin
insulin_therapy.observation: An extract of the pancreas keeps children with the sugar sickness alive and growing.
insulin_therapy.ability_reason: A sure death becomes a lifelong condition.

hospital_prepayment_plans.name: Hospital Prepayment
hospital_prepayment_plans.observation: Groups of workers pay a small sum each month and are cared for in hospital when they need it.

cancer_registries.name: Cancer Registries
cancer_registries.observation: Every cancer case is registered, and surgery and rays are combined by plan.

sulfa_drugs.name: Sulfa Drugs
sulfa_drugs.observation: A drug made from a red dye cures blood poisoning and childbed fever within days.
sulfa_drugs.ability_reason: Childbed fever and wound infection stop being death sentences.

blood_bank.name: Blood Bank
blood_bank.observation: Donated blood is typed, stored and issued to any hospital that calls.

mould_broth_antibiotic.name: Mould Antibiotic
mould_broth_antibiotic.observation: A drug from a mould, grown in deep tanks, cures pneumonia, wound infections and the pox.
mould_broth_antibiotic.ability_reason: Infections that killed at every age now yield to a course of injections.

consumption_antibiotic.name: TB Antibiotic
consumption_antibiotic.observation: A drug from a soil germ cures the wasting cough, and the sanatoria begin to empty.

water_fluoridation.name: Fluoridation
water_fluoridation.observation: A trace of fluoride is added to town water, and children's teeth decay far less.

residual_house_spraying.name: House Spraying
residual_house_spraying.observation: Every house wall is sprayed with a lasting insecticide, and the marsh fever retreats from whole provinces.

artificial_kidney_dialysis.name: Dialysis
artificial_kidney_dialysis.observation: A machine cleans the blood of patients whose kidneys have failed.

inter_realm_health_council.name: Health Council
inter_realm_health_council.observation: A council of realms pools disease reports and sets common standards for drugs and vaccines.

national_health_service.name: National Health Service
national_health_service.observation: One national service gives care free to everyone, paid for from taxes.
national_health_service.ability_reason: Nobody goes without a doctor because they cannot pay.
national_health_service.social_consequence: A national health ministry becomes the realm's largest employer; its budget is fought over every year.

randomised_controlled_trial.name: Controlled Trial
randomised_controlled_trial.observation: Patients are allotted by lot to the new treatment or the old, and the outcome decides.
randomised_controlled_trial.ability_reason: Treatments are proven or discarded by fair test, not authority.

tobacco_cancer_evidence.name: Tobacco Evidence
tobacco_cancer_evidence.observation: Studies of thousands of smokers prove that tobacco smoke causes cancer of the lung.

antipsychotic_drugs.name: Calming Drugs
antipsychotic_drugs.observation: Calming drugs quiet the voices, and many asylum patients go home.

combination_consumption_therapy.name: Combined TB Therapy
combination_consumption_therapy.observation: Several drugs given together defeat the wasting cough germs that resist one drug alone.

heart_lung_machine.name: Heart-lung Machine
heart_lung_machine.observation: A machine breathes and pumps for the patient while the heart is opened and repaired.

intensive_care_units.name: Intensive Care
intensive_care_units.observation: Intensive care wards keep the gravely ill alive with breathing machines and constant nursing.

organ_transplant.name: Organ Transplant
organ_transplant.observation: A kidney is transplanted from one twin to the other, and it works.

paralysis_virus_vaccine.name: Paralysis Vaccine
paralysis_virus_vaccine.observation: A killed-virus vaccine grown in cell culture protects children from the crippling summer paralysis.
paralysis_virus_vaccine.ability_reason: Summer no longer brings the fear of crippled children.

cardiac_resuscitation.name: Resuscitation
cardiac_resuscitation.observation: Chest compression, rescue breathing and an electric shock bring back hearts that had stopped.

drug_efficacy_approval.name: Drug Approval
drug_efficacy_approval.observation: New drugs must prove safety and benefit in trials before they may be sold.

community_mental_health.name: Community Mental Health
community_mental_health.observation: Community clinics replace the great asylums, and patients live among their neighbours.

measles_vaccine.name: Measles Vaccine
measles_vaccine.observation: A live weakened measles vaccine protects children from the fever that killed many each winter.

tobacco_control_laws.name: Tobacco Control
tobacco_control_laws.observation: Tobacco packets carry warnings, taxes rise and advertising is limited.

hospice_care.name: Hospice Care
hospice_care.observation: Hospices care for the dying and ease their pain at the end.

oral_rehydration_salts.name: Oral Rehydration
oral_rehydration_salts.observation: A drink of clean water with sugar and salt, given by the mother, stops children dying of diarrhoea.
oral_rehydration_salts.ability_reason: The commonest killer of children can now be treated at home by anyone.

body_slice_scanner.name: Slice Scanner
body_slice_scanner.observation: A rotating ray scanner draws slices through the body, and tumours and bleeds are found without cutting.

expanded_immunisation_program.name: Immunisation Program
expanded_immunisation_program.observation: Every child's vaccinations are scheduled and tracked as one program.

primary_health_care.name: Primary Care
primary_health_care.observation: Village health workers and clinics bring basic care within reach of every household.

smallpox_eradication.name: Smallpox Eradication
smallpox_eradication.observation: Vaccinators ring each case with vaccinated contacts until the last smallpox case is found and closed.
smallpox_eradication.ability_reason: An ancient killer is gone for good.

magnetic_resonance_imaging.name: Magnetic Imaging
magnetic_resonance_imaging.observation: Magnets and radio waves picture the soft tissues of brain and joint.

immune_virus_blood_test.name: Immune Virus Test
immune_virus_blood_test.observation: A blood test finds the wasting immune virus, and donated blood is screened.

recombinant_vaccine.name: Recombinant Vaccine
recombinant_vaccine.observation: Yeast carrying one viral gene makes a safe vaccine against the liver virus.

cholesterol_lowering_drugs.name: Cholesterol Drugs
cholesterol_lowering_drugs.observation: Daily tablets lower the fat in the blood and prevent many heart attacks.

systematic_review_medicine.name: Systematic Reviews
systematic_review_medicine.observation: All trials of a treatment are gathered and pooled, and care follows the evidence.

insecticide_bed_nets.name: Bed Nets
insecticide_bed_nets.observation: Nets dipped in insecticide hang over sleeping children, and marsh-fever deaths fall.

combination_antiviral_therapy.name: Antiviral Therapy
combination_antiviral_therapy.observation: Three drugs taken together hold the immune virus in check, and patients live for decades.
combination_antiviral_therapy.ability_reason: A fatal plague of the young becomes a managed illness.

monoclonal_antibody_drugs.name: Antibody Drugs
monoclonal_antibody_drugs.observation: Engineered antibodies are made in cell culture as drugs against cancer and inflammation.

antibiotic_stewardship.name: Antibiotic Stewardship
antibiotic_stewardship.observation: Antibiotics are rationed to real need, and resistant germs are watched in every hospital.

artemisinin_combination_therapy.name: Wormwood Therapy
artemisinin_combination_therapy.observation: A drug from sweet wormwood, given with a partner drug, cures marsh fever that resists the old medicines.

human_genome_reading.name: Genome Reading
human_genome_reading.observation: The whole hereditary text of a human being is read letter by letter.

tobacco_control_treaty.name: Tobacco Treaty
tobacco_control_treaty.observation: Realms sign a treaty on tobacco, and smoking is banned indoors.

inter_realm_health_rules.name: Outbreak Rules
inter_realm_health_rules.observation: Binding rules require every realm to report a new outbreak within a day.

electronic_health_records.name: Electronic Records
electronic_health_records.observation: Health records move with the patient between hospitals on electronic systems.

immune_checkpoint_therapy.name: Checkpoint Therapy
immune_checkpoint_therapy.observation: Drugs release the immune system's brake, and some cancers melt away.

engineered_immune_cell_therapy.name: Engineered Cell Therapy
engineered_immune_cell_therapy.observation: A patient's own immune cells are re-engineered to kill a blood cancer.

messenger_molecule_vaccine.name: Message-molecule Vaccine
messenger_molecule_vaccine.observation: A vaccine is designed in days from the genetic text of a new virus and made by the million.
messenger_molecule_vaccine.ability_reason: A new pandemic can be met with a vaccine within a year.
messenger_molecule_vaccine.social_consequence: Vaccine doubts split households and quarrels reach the council chambers.

pandemic_test_trace_orders.name: Test and Trace
pandemic_test_trace_orders.observation: In a pandemic the people are tested in their millions, contacts traced and districts locked down.

malaria_vaccine.name: Malaria Vaccine
malaria_vaccine.observation: The first vaccine against marsh fever protects small children in fever country.

gene_edited_blood_cure.name: Gene-edited Blood Cure
gene_edited_blood_cure.observation: A single gene-editing treatment cures inherited sickle-cell blood disease.

machine_read_diagnostics.name: Machine Diagnostics
machine_read_diagnostics.observation: Machines read scans and slides and flag what a physician should check.

gut_hormone_drugs.name: Gut Hormone Drugs
gut_hormone_drugs.observation: Weekly injections of a gut hormone curb appetite and protect heart and kidneys.

genome_guided_prescribing.name: Genome-guided Prescribing
genome_guided_prescribing.observation: A patient's hereditary profile guides which drug and what dose.

broad_virus_family_vaccines.name: Broad Virus Vaccines
broad_virus_family_vaccines.observation: Broad vaccines against whole families of viruses are held ready for the next pandemic.
